# What each pipeline in Orders.Apps is for. Pipeline Insights reads this file.
pipelines:
  pipelines/file-import-app-build.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds the file import app image and pushes it to the registry. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/pricing-app-build.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds the pricing app image, with the models it loads, and pushes it to the registry. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/misc/unit-tests.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Lints and unit-tests every package in the apps repo, on pushes and as a pull request check. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/catalog-sync-etl-build.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds the catalog sync job image. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/ci_app-admin.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Tests the admin app on pushes to main and as a pull request check. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/vault_create-secret-scope.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Creates the secret scope a new warehouse region reads its credentials from. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/warehouse_deploy-region-east.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Deploys the east region warehouse bundle. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/warehouse_deploy-region-west.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Deploys the west region warehouse bundle. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/ci_db-tool.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Tests the database tool and checks the schema files on pushes and pull requests. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/build-deploy_ranker.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds and deploys the GPU and CPU ranker model endpoints. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/db-tool-job-build.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds the database tool job image that applies schema changes. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/db-tool-job-run.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Runs the database tool job against one environment. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/price-check-gate-job-build.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds the price check gate job image. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/price-check-gate.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Scores a candidate pricing model against the current one and fails if it is worse. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/model-retrain-run.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Retrains the pricing model each quarter and checks on the job until it finishes. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/pricing-app-deploy.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Deploys each new pricing app build to staging, then to production after approval. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/file-import-app-deploy.yaml:
    purpose: >-

      Builds the tools proxy image. (TODO: verify)

    purpose: >-
      Tests the storefront web app on pushes to main and as a pull request check. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/webapp-storefront-build.yaml:
    purpose: >-
      Builds the storefront web app image. (TODO: verify)
  pipelines/webapp-storefront-deploy.yaml:

      Deploys each new storefront build to staging, then region by region to production after approval. (TODO: verify)
